name: Margaret McDermott
headline: Director of Professional Services at NICE CXone
location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
about:
Known for blending strategic vision with operational pragmatism, I excel at helping enterprises evolve from traditional service models to data‑driven, predictive, and digitally augmented customer journeys. My leadership spans multi site operations, professional services, solution architecture, and executive client partnership. I thrive at the intersection of CX strategy, AI innovation, and operational excellence, and am a trusted advisor to C suite executives seeking to modernize their customer experience and accelerate enterprise wide transformation. Recognized for developing high performing teams, influencing enterprise level decisions, and delivering consistent revenue growth across consulting, operations, and solution architecture roles.

🔹 Professional Background: As a seasoned BPO leader, I excel in operations, project management, and corporate real estate, enabling organizations to embrace growth and navigate change seamlessly within their contact centers.

🔹 Leadership Positions: Throughout my career, I've held pivotal roles such as Relationship Management, Operations Director, Project Implementation Lead, and Asset Management Expert. My skill set encompasses operational excellence, client relationship management, employee satisfaction and development, as well as budget management.

🔹 Passion for Mentorship: I'm deeply passionate about mentoring and nurturing talent. I possess a remarkable ability to identify emerging leaders and guide them towards realizing their full potential, fostering a culture of continuous learning and professional growth.

🔹 Specialties: My expertise spans a spectrum of disciplines, including CX Strategy & Transformation, Operational Excellence, Data Driven Insights (Power BI, Salesforce), Leadership Coaching, Team Collaboration, Thought Leadership, Performance Management, Operations Management, Leadership Development, 

🔹 Academic Involvement: I'm honored to serve as an Associate Instructor for the University of Utah Professional Education department, where I inspire future leaders & professionals with essential skills in teamwork, trust-building, effective meeting management, and communication strategies.

🏞️ Life Beyond Work: Outside the office, you'll find me exploring the breathtaking landscapes of Utah through hiking, biking, canyoneering, and paddleboarding. I'm also an avid learner, constantly seeking out new experiences and knowledge. 

Let's Connect! I'm passionate about leveraging my expertise to drive success and foster growth. Feel free to reach out for collaboration or networking opportunities.
